meta.name: cloudwatch
meta.description: AWS CloudWatch monitoring for logs, metrics, alarms, and dashboards. Use when setting up monitoring, creating alarms, querying logs with Insights, configuring metric filters, building dashboards, or troubleshooting application issues.

copy.tagline: 监控 AWS 日志、指标和告警
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 AWS 并需要集中监控云资源
copy.tagline_en: Monitor AWS logs, metrics, and alarms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AWS and need centralized cloud monitoring

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 AWS CloudWatch 监控，包括查看指标、查询日志、创建告警、设置仪表盘和排查问题。
howto.when: 当你需要设置 AWS 资源监控、创建告警、用 Insights 查询日志、配置指标筛选、构建仪表盘或排查应用问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 EC2 CPU 使用率超过 80% 的告警。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 CLI 或 boto3 命令。

say.text: 查询 Lambda 函数过去一小时的错误日志。
创建一个仪表盘，显示 Lambda 调用次数和最近错误。
say.note: Claude 会生成仪表盘 JSON 并指导创建。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage AWS CloudWatch monitoring, including viewing metrics, querying logs, creating alarms, setting up dashboards, and troubleshooting issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to set up AWS resource monitoring, create alarms, query logs with Insights, configure metric filters, build dashboards, or troubleshoot application issues.

say_en.text: Create an alarm for EC2 CPU utilization above 80%.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding CLI or boto3 command.

say_en.text: Query error logs from my Lambda function in the past hour.
say_en.note: Claude will use Logs Insights to query and return results.

say_en.text: Create a dashboard showing Lambda invocations and recent errors.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the dashboard JSON and guide you through creation.
